metadata.title: Country Western Portrait with Duotone Texture

retrievalProfile.description: A monochromatic duotone portrait of a man in western attire featuring high-contrast lighting and ultra-condensed, lowercase display typography.
excludeWhen: modern high-definition color photography is required
urban or futuristic themes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a man wearing a wide-brimmed cowboy hat and a patterned western shirt, rendered in a grainy, desaturated green duotone with stark lighting and stylized condensed text at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark cowboy hat frames the upper third of the subject's face
The vertical stripes of the shirt echo the verticality of the condensed typeface
The subject's gaze is directed slightly off-camera, creating a candid but intense mood
Text is positioned in the upper right quadrant to balance the subject's lean to the left
coreInvariants: Desaturated green and black duotone color palette
Heavy film grain texture across the entire image
Ultra-condensed vertical typography with wide letter spacing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame, leaning slightly to the left, captured from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, wide-brimmed cowboy hat serves as the primary visual anchor against the lighter background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the hat, moves down to the subject's face, follows the shirt patterns downward, and then moves up to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper third of the frame provides a canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep forest green shadows and midtones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the dark hat/shirt stripes and the pale skin/background.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase only for the primary title
Uniform stroke width with slight serif-like flares at terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'g' features a simplified, elongated loop
The 'h' and 'k' have exaggeratedly tall ascenders
The 's' is compressed into a narrow vertical squiggle

composition.relationshipToImage: floats in negative space above subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair the elongated lowercase display text with a smaller, all-caps sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and condensed nature
Provides the necessary narrowness and clean terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, duotone green photograph of a man in a cowboy hat and striped western shirt, looking slightly away from the camera, with ample empty space at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed, vertically stretched lowercase text in white in the upper right corner with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly duotone green?
Is the text extremely narrow and tall?
Is there a heavy grain texture visible?
Is the text lowercase and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Vertical stretch ratio of the typography

mustAchieve: Legible but highly stylized condensed type

postGenerationChecks: Check that the green hue is consistent across highlights and shadows
Ensure the cowboy hat does not merge into the background
Verify the text is lowercase and vertically elongated
Confirm the grain is uniform across the entire composition
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait Subject (Western) + Duotone Green Filter + Heavy Film Grain + Ultra-Condensed Lowercase Typography
